title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-05
lineage: AUD > MR > R > DAT > CD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Stunning 1971 audience tape with crystal‑clear sound and a smoking first set highlighted by Bertha, Mr. Charlie and a monster Cryptical > Drums > Other One.
ai_review.review: This audience recording captures an electrifying night from ’71 – the mix is remarkably clear with excellent frequency balance, letting every instrument shine. The first set is a showcase of peak Dead energy (Bertha, Mr. Charlie, Cryptical → Drums → Other One, Casey Jones) while the second set, though slightly weaker to some listeners, still delivers the psychedelic vibe the band is known for.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both the musical performance and the high‑fidelity audience capture; minor criticisms (missing tracks, slight second‑set dip) only modestly lower an otherwise top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear instrument separation, solid frequency response and crisp highs; some reviewers note missing tracks (Bird Song, Not Fade) and a possible source change in the second set, but overall the tape is praised as one of the best 1971 audience recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is consistently praised for its power and tightness; the second set is described as a bit weaker but still solid, maintaining the show’s overall high energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Forgot to sing until the third verse of Bertha, but his guitar work on Other One and overall tone are lauded.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ/harmonica contributions are noted, adding to the psychedelic texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum segment within Cryptical > Drums > Other One is highlighted as a standout moment.
